gita.text: In this there is no loss of effort, nor is there transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects from great fear.
gita.why: No sincere effort is wasted, and even a little wisdom guards against great fear.

gita.text: The determinate Reason is but one-pointed, O joy of the Kurus; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the irresolute.
gita.why: A focused mind is single; a scattered mind runs in endless directions.

gita.text: Thy business is with the action only, never with its fruits; so let not the fruit of action be thy motive, nor be thou to inaction attached.
gita.why: Do your work for its own sake, not for the reward, and do not give up acting.

gita.text: Perform action, O Dhananjaya, dwelling in union with the divine, renouncing attachments and balanced evenly in success and failure: equilibrium is called yoga.
gita.why: Work without clinging, staying even in success and failure; that balance is yoga.

gita.text: When a man abandoneth, O Partha, all the desires of the heart, and is satisfied in the Self by the Self, then is he called stable in mind.
gita.why: When you let go of restless cravings and rest content within, the mind grows stable.

gita.text: He whose mind is free from anxiety amid pains, indifferent amid pleasures, loosed from passion, fear and anger, is called a sage of stable mind.
gita.why: The wise stay untroubled in pain, unexcited by pleasure, free from fear and anger.

gita.text: When, again, as a tortoise draws in on all sides its limbs, he withdraws his senses from the objects of sense, then is his understanding well poised.
gita.why: Like a tortoise drawing in its limbs, draw your senses back from what pulls at them.

gita.text: O son of Kunti, the excited senses of even a wise man, though he be striving, impetuously carry away his mind.
gita.why: Even a wise person who is trying can be carried away by restless senses.

gita.text: Man, musing on the objects of sense, conceiveth an attachment to these; from attachment ariseth desire; from desire anger cometh forth.
gita.why: Dwelling on things breeds attachment, attachment breeds craving, and craving breeds anger.

gita.text: Such of the roving senses as the mind yieldeth to, that hurries away the understanding, just as the gale hurries away a ship upon the waters.
gita.why: Senses the mind gives in to drag understanding off course, like a gale driving a ship.

gita.text: He attaineth Peace, into whom all desires flow as rivers flow into the ocean, which is filled with water, but remaineth unmoved - not he who desireth desires.
gita.why: Peace comes to one who stays calm like the ocean as desires flow in, not to one chasing them.

gita.text: Man winneth not freedom from action by abstaining from activity, nor by mere renunciation doth he rise to perfection.
gita.why: Freedom does not come from avoiding work or merely giving things up.

gita.text: Who, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, with the organs of action without attachment, performeth yoga by action, he is worthy.
gita.why: Master your senses with your mind and work without clinging; that is worthy.

gita.text: Perform thou right action, for, action is superior to inaction, and, inactive, even the maintenance of thy body would not be possible.
gita.why: Do right action; action is better than inaction.

gita.text: Without attachment, constantly perform action which is duty, for, by performing action without attachment, man verily reacheth the Supreme.
gita.why: Do your duty steadily without clinging to results; this leads to the highest.

gita.text: Janaka and others indeed attained to perfection by action: then having an eye to the welfare of the world also, thou shouldst perform action.
gita.why: Great souls reached fulfilment through action; work also for the good of the world.

gita.text: Affection and aversion for the objects of sense abide in the senses; let none come under the dominion of these two; they are obstructors of the path.
gita.why: Do not let likes and dislikes rule you; they block the path.

gita.text: It is desire, it is wrath, begotten by the quality of motion; all-consuming, all-polluting, know thou this as our foe here on earth.
gita.why: Runaway desire and anger are the real enemy within, consuming and polluting all they touch.

gita.text: Enveloped is wisdom by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire, which is insatiable as a flame.
gita.why: Unchecked desire, insatiable as a flame, clouds even a wise person's judgment.

gita.text: Having thus known, our forefathers, ever seeking liberation, performed action; therefore do thou also perform action, as did our forefathers in the olden time.
gita.why: Those who came before us worked steadily while seeking freedom; follow their example.

gita.text: He who seeth inaction in action, and action in inaction, he is wise among men, he is harmonious, even while performing all action.
gita.why: The wise see stillness within action and action within stillness, staying balanced while doing everything.

gita.text: Having abandoned attachment to the fruit of action, always content, nowhere seeking refuge, he is not doing anything, although doing actions.
gita.why: Letting go of attachment to results, always content, one stays free even while busy.

gita.text: Content with whatsoever he obtaineth without effort, free from the pairs of opposites, without envy, balanced in success and failure, though acting he is not bound.
gita.why: Content with what comes, free of envy, balanced in success and failure, one is not bound.

gita.text: Better than the sacrifice of any objects is the sacrifice of wisdom, O Parantapa. All actions in their entirety, O Partha, culminate in wisdom.
gita.why: Offering wisdom is greater than offering things; all action finds its fulfilment in wisdom.

gita.text: Verily there is no purifier in this world like wisdom; he that is perfected in yoga finds it in the Self in due season.
gita.why: Nothing in the world purifies like wisdom, and in time it is found within.

gita.text: Renunciation and yoga by action both lead to the highest bliss; of the two, yoga by action is verily better than renunciation of action.
gita.why: Both letting go and active work lead to the highest good, but selfless action is the better way.

gita.text: He should be known as a perpetual ascetic, who neither hateth nor desireth; free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed, he is easily set free from bondage.
gita.why: One who neither hates nor craves is easily set free.

gita.text: He who acteth, placing all actions in the Eternal, abandoning attachment, is unaffected by sin as a lotus leaf by the waters.
gita.why: Work without clinging and stay untouched, like a lotus leaf on water.

gita.text: Even here on earth everything is overcome by those whose mind remains balanced; the Eternal is incorruptible and balanced; therefore they are established in the Eternal.
gita.why: A balanced mind overcomes everything, even here and now.

gita.text: With Reason firm, unperplexed, the knower of the Eternal established in the Eternal, neither rejoiceth on obtaining what is pleasant, nor sorroweth on obtaining what is unpleasant.
gita.why: A steady mind does not soar at good fortune nor sink at bad.

gita.text: He, whose self is unattached to external contacts and findeth joy in the Self, having the self harmonised with the Eternal by yoga, enjoys imperishable bliss.
gita.why: Joy found within, not in outside things, is lasting.

gita.text: The higher Self of him who is Self-controlled and peaceful is uniform in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honour and dishonour.
gita.why: One who is self-controlled and peaceful stays even in heat and cold, pain and pleasure, honour and dishonour.

gita.text: The Yogi who is satisfied with wisdom and knowledge, unwavering, whose senses are subdued, to whom a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same, is said to be harmonised.
gita.why: To the truly wise, a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same.

gita.text: He who regards impartially lovers, friends, and foes, strangers, neutrals, foreigners and relatives, also the righteous and unrighteous, he excelleth.
gita.why: Regard lovers, friends and foes, strangers, foreigners and relatives, the righteous and the unrighteous, with an even mind.

gita.text: Verily yoga is not for him who eateth too much, nor who abstaineth to excess, nor who is too much addicted to sleep, nor even to wakefulness, O Arjuna.
gita.why: Balance matters: not too much eating or fasting, not too much sleep or wakefulness.

gita.text: As a lamp in a windless place flickereth not, to such is likened the Yogi of subdued thought, absorbed in the yoga of the Self.
gita.why: A calm mind is like a lamp in a windless place that does not flicker.

gita.text: As often as the wavering and unsteady mind goeth forth, so often reining it in, let him bring it under the control of the Self.
gita.why: Each time the restless mind wanders off, rein it in and bring it back under control.

gita.text: The self, harmonised by yoga, seeth the Self abiding in all beings, all beings in the Self; everywhere he seeth the same.
gita.why: The harmonised person sees the same Self in all beings and all beings in that Self.

gita.text: He who seeth Me everywhere, and seeth everything in Me, of him will I never lose hold, and he shall never lose hold of Me.
gita.why: Whoever sees God everywhere is never let go, and never lets go of God.

gita.text: He who, through the likeness of the Self, O Arjuna, seeth equality in everything, whether pleasant or painful, he is considered a perfect Yogi.
gita.why: One who sees others as like oneself, and sees equality in everything pleasant or painful, is a perfect yogi.

gita.text: The mind is verily restless, O Krishna; it is impetuous, strong and difficult to bend. I deem it as hard to curb as the wind.
gita.why: The mind is restless, strong and hard to steady, as hard to hold as the wind.

gita.text: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is hard to curb and restless; but it may be curbed by constant practice and by dispassion.
gita.why: The restless mind is hard to steady, but it can be done through steady practice and letting go.

gita.text: Fourfold in division are the righteous ones who worship me, O Arjuna; the suffering, the seeker for knowledge, the self-interested and the wise, O Lord of the Bharatas.
gita.why: The suffering, the seeker, the one in need and the wise are all counted among the faithful.

gita.text: The same am I to all beings; there is none hateful to Me nor dear. They verily who worship Me with devotion, they are in Me, and I also in them.
gita.why: God is the same to all beings; no one is hateful to God, and the devoted live in God.

gita.text: Whatsoever is glorious, good, beautiful, and mighty, understand thou that to go forth from a fragment of My splendour.
gita.why: Whatever is glorious, good, beautiful and strong comes from a spark of the divine splendour.

gita.text: If also thou art not equal to constant practice, be intent on My service; performing actions for My sake, thou shalt attain perfection.
gita.why: If constant practice is beyond you, devote yourself to God's service; doing your actions for His sake, you will reach perfection.

gita.text: Better indeed is wisdom than constant-practice; than wisdom, meditation is better; than meditation, renunciation of the fruit of action; on renunciation follows peace.
gita.why: Letting go of the fruits of your work is followed by peace.

gita.text: He from whom the world doth not shrink away, who doth not shrink away from the world, freed from the anxieties of joy, anger, and fear, he is dear to me.
gita.why: One whom the world need not shrink from, who does not shrink from the world, free of anxious swings of joy, anger and fear, is dear to God.

gita.text: That, the Light of all lights, is said to be beyond darkness; Wisdom, the Object of Wisdom, by Wisdom to be reached, seated in the hearts of all.
gita.why: The Light of all lights, beyond all darkness, is seated in every heart.

gita.text: Seated equally in all beings, the supreme Lord, unperishing within the perishing - he who thus seeth, he seeth.
gita.why: One who sees the same divine presence dwelling equally in all beings truly sees.

gita.text: Without pride and delusion, victorious over the vice of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, desire pacified, liberated from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they tread, undeluded, that indestructible path.
gita.why: Free of pride and clinging, with desires stilled and beyond pleasure and pain, the wise walk the lasting path.

gita.text: Fearlessness, cleanness of life, steadfastness in the Yoga of wisdom, almsgiving, self-restraint and sacrifice and study of the Scriptures, austerity and straightforwardness.
gita.why: Fearlessness, a clean life, generosity, self-restraint, study and straightforwardness are marks of a good life.

gita.text: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion to living beings, uncovetousness, mildness, modesty, absence of fickleness.
gita.why: Harmlessness, truth, freedom from anger, peacefulness, compassion to all, gentleness and modesty are marks of goodness.

gita.text: The faith of each is shaped to his own nature, O Bharata. The man consists of his faith; that which his faith is, he is even that.
gita.why: A person becomes what they truly believe in; their faith shapes who they are.

gita.text: Speech causing no annoyance, truthful, pleasant and beneficial, the practice of the study of the Scriptures, are called the austerity of speech.
gita.why: Speak words that do not hurt, that are truthful, kind and helpful.

gita.text: He who performeth a prescribed action, saying, "it ought to be done," O Arjuna, relinquishing attachment and also fruit, that relinquishment is regarded as pure.
gita.why: Do what ought to be done simply because it should be done, without clinging to the result.

gita.text: The relinquisher pervaded by purity, intelligent and with doubts cut away, hateth not unpleasurable action nor is attached to pleasurable.
gita.why: A clear-minded person does not resent unpleasant work nor cling to pleasant work.

gita.text: Nor indeed can embodied beings completely relinquish action; verily he who relinquisheth the fruit of action, he is said to be a relinquisher.
gita.why: No one can give up action entirely; what matters is letting go of the fruits of action.

gita.text: That by which one indestructible Being is seen in all beings, inseparate in the separated, know thou that knowledge as pure.
gita.why: True knowledge sees one undying being in all beings, undivided among the divided.

gita.text: The action undertaken from delusion, without regard to capacity and consequences - loss and injury to others - that is declared to be dark.
gita.why: Acting rashly, without regard for your strength or the harm and loss to others, is the darkest kind of action.

gita.text: Liberated from attachment, not egoistic, endued with firmness and confidence, unchanged by success or failure, that actor is called pure.
gita.why: Work without clinging or ego, with steadiness and confidence, unchanged by success or failure.

gita.text: That which knoweth energy and abstinence, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation, that Reason is pure, O Partha.
gita.why: Clear understanding knows when to act and when to hold back, what to fear and what not to fear.

gita.text: That which from the union of the senses with their objects at first is as nectar, but in the end is like venom, that pleasure is accounted passionate.
gita.why: Pleasure that is like nectar at first but like poison in the end is called passionate.

quran.text: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
quran.why: Praise and thanks to the Lord of all the worlds.

quran.text: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.
quran.why: We have no knowledge except what God has taught us; only He is the Knower, the Wise.

quran.text: Confound not truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the truth.
quran.why: Do not mix truth with falsehood or hide what is true.

quran.text: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded.
quran.why: Seek help in patience and prayer; it is hard, except for the humble.

quran.text: Unto Allah belong the East and the West, and whithersoever ye turn, there is Allah's Countenance. Lo! Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
quran.why: Wherever you turn, God is there; you are never out of reach.

quran.text: Remember Me, I will remember you. Give thanks to Me, and reject not Me.
quran.why: Remember God and He remembers you; give thanks.

quran.text: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of night and day, and the ships which run upon the sea with that which is of use to men, and the water which Allah sendeth down from the sky, thereby reviving the earth after its death, and dispersing all kinds of beasts therein, and (in) the ordinance of the winds, and the clouds obedient between heaven and earth: are signs (of Allah's Sovereignty) for people who have sense.
quran.why: The order of nature, night and day, sea and rain, holds signs for those who think.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and render thanks to Allah if it is (indeed) He Whom ye worship.
quran.why: Enjoy the good things you are given and be thankful.

quran.text: Eat not up your property among yourselves in vanity, nor seek by it to gain the hearing of the judges that ye may knowingly devour a portion of the property of others wrongfully.
quran.why: Do not take others' property wrongfully or bribe your way to it.

quran.text: That which ye spend for good (must go) to parents and near kindred and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. And whatsoever good ye do, lo! Allah is Aware of it.
quran.why: Spend for good on parents, kin, orphans, the needy and travellers; God knows every good deed.

quran.text: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.
quran.why: God never sleeps and never tires of preserving the heavens and the earth; all of it belongs to Him.

quran.text: The likeness of those who spend their wealth in Allah's way is as the likeness of a grain which groweth seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains. Allah giveth increase manifold to whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
quran.why: Giving is like a grain that grows seven ears, each with a hundred grains.

quran.text: A kind word with forgiveness is better than almsgiving followed by injury. Allah is Absolute, Clement.
quran.why: A kind word and forgiveness are better than charity followed by hurt.

quran.text: He giveth wisdom unto whom He will, and he unto whom wisdom is given, he truly hath received abundant good. But none remember except men of understanding.
quran.why: Whoever is given wisdom has been given abundant good.

quran.text: If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you, and will atone for some of your ill-deeds. Allah is Informed of what ye do.
quran.why: Giving openly is good, but giving quietly to the poor is better.

quran.text: For the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.
quran.why: Look out for the poor who are in need but too dignified to beg, and help them.

quran.text: If the debtor is in straitened circumstances, then (let there be) postponement to (the time of) ease; and that ye remit the debt as almsgiving would be better for you if ye did but know.
quran.why: Give a struggling debtor time, and forgiving the debt is better still.

quran.text: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.
quran.why: A prayer that the heart not stray once it has found its way.

quran.text: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.
quran.why: You do not reach true goodness until you give from what you love.

quran.text: There may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.
quran.why: Be people who invite others to goodness; that is true success.

quran.text: Those who, when they do an evil thing or wrong themselves, remember Allah and implore forgiveness for their sins - Who forgiveth sins save Allah only? - and will not knowingly repeat (the wrong) they did.
quran.why: When people do wrong, they remember God, ask forgiveness and do not knowingly repeat it; only God forgives sins.

quran.text: Allah is your Protector, and He is the Best of Helpers.
quran.why: God is your protector, the best of helpers.

quran.text: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth and (in) the difference of night and day are tokens (of His Sovereignty) for men of understanding.
quran.why: Creation and the change of night and day are signs for thoughtful people.

quran.text: O mankind! Be careful of your duty to your Lord Who created you from a single soul and from it created its mate and from them twain hath spread abroad a multitude of men and women. Be careful of your duty toward Allah in Whom ye claim (your rights) of one another, and toward the wombs (that bare you). Lo! Allah hath been a watcher over you.
quran.why: All people come from one soul; honour the ties of kinship.

quran.text: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.
quran.why: God wants to lighten your burden, for people were created weak.

quran.text: Covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others. Unto men a fortune from that which they have earned, and unto women a fortune from that which they have earned. (Envy not one another) but ask Allah of His bounty. Lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.
quran.why: Do not covet what others have; ask God of His bounty instead.

quran.text: Lo! Allah wrongeth not even of the weight of an ant; and if there is a good deed, He will double it and will give (the doer) from His presence an immense reward.
quran.why: Not even an ant's weight of good is lost; good deeds are multiplied.

quran.text: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.
quran.why: Return what is entrusted to you and judge between people fairly.

quran.text: Whoso interveneth in a good cause will have the reward thereof, and whoso interveneth in an evil cause will bear the consequence thereof. Allah overseeth all things.
quran.why: Whoever stands up for a good cause shares in its reward.

quran.text: When ye are greeted with a greeting, greet ye with a better than it or return it. Lo! Allah taketh count of all things.
quran.why: When greeted, return the greeting with one better or equal.

quran.text: There is no good in much of their secret conferences save (in) him who enjoineth almsgiving and kindness and peace-making among the people. Whoso doeth that, seeking the good pleasure of Allah, We shall bestow on him a vast reward.
quran.why: There is no good in much secret talk, except in urging charity, kindness and making peace between people.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Be ye staunch in justice, witnesses for Allah, even though it be against yourselves or (your) parents or (your) kindred, whether (the case be of) a rich man or a poor man, for Allah is nearer unto both (them ye are). So follow not passion lest ye lapse (from truth) and if ye lapse or fall away, then lo! Allah is ever Informed of what ye do.
quran.why: Stand firm for justice even against yourself or your family.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Be steadfast witnesses for Allah in equity, and let not hatred of any people seduce you that ye deal not justly. Deal justly, that is nearer to your duty. Observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.
quran.why: Do not let hatred of anyone push you into being unjust.

quran.text: Whoso repenteth after his wrongdoing and amendeth, lo! Allah will relent toward him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: Whoever repents after doing wrong and makes amends is forgiven.

quran.text: When those who believe in Our revelations come unto thee, say: Peace be unto you! Your Lord hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that whoso of you doeth evil through ignorance and repenteth afterward thereof and doeth right, (for him) lo! He is Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: Peace be on you: whoever does wrong in ignorance, repents and mends finds mercy.

quran.text: With Him are the keys of the Invisible. None but He knoweth them. And He knoweth what is in the land and the sea. Not a leaf falleth but He knoweth it, not a grain amid the darkness of the earth, naught of wet or dry but (it is noted) in a clear record.
quran.why: Not a leaf falls without God knowing; nothing is unseen.

quran.text: He is the Cleaver of the Daybreak, and He hath appointed the night for stillness, and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
quran.why: God made the night for stillness and rest.

quran.text: He it is Who hath set for you the stars that ye may guide your course by them amid the darkness of the land and the sea. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who have knowledge.
quran.why: The stars are given to guide your way through darkness.

quran.text: Whoso bringeth a good deed will receive tenfold the like thereof, while whoso bringeth an ill-deed will be awarded but the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.
quran.why: A good deed is rewarded ten times over.

quran.text: My Lord! Have mercy on me and on my brother; bring us into Thy mercy, Thou the Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
quran.why: A prayer for mercy on oneself and one's brother.

quran.text: Those who do ill-deeds and afterward repent and believe - lo! for them, afterward, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: Those who did wrong and then repented find God forgiving and merciful.

quran.text: Do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.
quran.why: Remember your Lord within yourself, humbly and quietly, morning and evening.

quran.text: Others who have acknowledged their faults. They mixed a righteous action with another that was bad. It may be that Allah will relent toward them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: Those who admit their faults, having mixed good with bad, may hope for mercy.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Be careful of your duty to Allah, and be with the truthful.
quran.why: Keep company with the truthful.

quran.text: O mankind! There hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, a balm for that which is in the breasts, a guidance and a mercy for believers.
quran.why: Guidance comes as a balm for what is in the heart.

quran.text: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.
quran.why: Rejoice in God's bounty and mercy; it is better than anything hoarded.

quran.text: He it is Who hath appointed for you the night that ye should rest therein and the day giving sight. Lo! herein verily are portents for a folk that heed.
quran.why: The night was given you to rest in, and the day to see by.

quran.text: There is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record.
quran.why: Every creature's sustenance rests with God, who knows where each one dwells.

quran.text: Our messengers came unto Abraham with good news. They said: Peace! He answered: Peace! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf.
quran.why: Abraham greets strangers with peace and hurries to feed them.

quran.text: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption.
quran.why: Give full measure and weight, and do not cheat people of their goods.

quran.text: He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on a clear proof from my Lord and He sustaineth me with fair sustenance from Him (how can I concede aught to you)? I desire not to do behind your backs that which I ask you not to do. I desire naught save reform so far as I am able. My welfare is only in Allah. In Him I trust and unto Him I turn (repentant).
quran.why: Shu'aib says he wants only to set things right as far as he can, and that his welfare rests in God.

quran.text: Establish worship at the two ends of the day and in some watches of the night. Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds. This is reminder for the mindful.
quran.why: Good deeds wipe away bad ones.

quran.text: Have patience, (O Muhammad), for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.
quran.why: Be patient; God does not let the reward of the good be lost.

quran.text: He said: O my sons! Go not in by one gate; go in by different gates. I can naught avail you as against Allah. Lo! the decision rests with Allah only. In Him do I put my trust, and in Him let all the trusting put their trust.
quran.why: A father takes sensible precautions for his sons, then puts his trust in God.

quran.text: He turned away from them and said: Alas, my grief for Joseph! And his eyes were whitened with the sorrow that he was suppressing.
quran.why: Jacob turned away and grieved for Joseph, his eyes whitened by the sorrow he held in.

quran.text: I expose my distress and anguish only unto Allah, and I know from Allah that which ye know not.
quran.why: I pour out my distress and sorrow only to God.

quran.text: He placed his parents on the dais and they fell down before him prostrate, and he said: O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream of old. My Lord hath made it true, and He hath shown me kindness, since He took me out of the prison and hath brought you from the desert after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren. Lo! my Lord is tender unto whom He will. He is the Knower, the Wise.
quran.why: Joseph, reunited with his parents, says God was kind to him in freeing him from prison and bringing them out of the desert after Satan caused strife with his brothers.

quran.text: Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!
quran.why: In the remembrance of God hearts find rest.

quran.text: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven.
quran.why: A good word is like a good tree, rooted firm with branches in the sky.

quran.text: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.
quran.why: A parent's prayer for themselves and their children to be steady in prayer.

quran.text: If ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: If you tried to count God's blessings, you could not number them.

quran.text: Whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help.
quran.why: Every comfort you enjoy is from God.

quran.text: Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks.
quran.why: You were born knowing nothing and given hearing, sight and hearts, so be grateful.

quran.text: Whosoever doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, him verily we shall quicken with good life, and We shall pay them a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.
quran.why: Whoever does right, man or woman, will be given a good life.

quran.text: Eat of the lawful and good food which Allah hath provided for you, and thank the bounty of your Lord if it is Him ye serve.
quran.why: Eat of the good things provided and be thankful.

quran.text: Lo! thy Lord - for those who do evil in ignorance and afterward repent and amend - lo! (for them) thy Lord is afterward indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
quran.why: For those who did wrong in ignorance and then repented and mended, God forgives.

quran.text: Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright.
quran.why: Invite with wisdom and kind advice; reason with people in the best way.

quran.text: Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good.
quran.why: God is with those who do good.

quran.text: Your Lord is Best Aware of what is in your minds. If ye are righteous, then lo! He was ever Forgiving unto those who turn (unto Him).
quran.why: God knows what is in your heart and forgives those who turn back.

quran.text: Give the kinsman his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy wealth) in wantonness.
quran.why: Give relatives, the needy and travellers their due, and do not waste.

quran.text: Let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening, lest thou sit down rebuked, denuded.
quran.why: Be neither tight-fisted nor so lavish that you are left with nothing.

quran.text: Fill the measure when ye measure, and weigh with a right balance; that is meet, and better in the end.
quran.why: Measure fully and weigh fairly; it is better in the end.

quran.text: Follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.
quran.why: Do not follow what you have no knowledge of.

quran.text: Walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.
quran.why: Do not walk the earth with arrogance; you cannot split the earth or match the mountains.

quran.text: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.
quran.why: Tell people to say what is kindest, for the devil sows discord among them.

quran.text: Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment.
quran.why: Every child of Adam has been honoured.

quran.text: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.
quran.why: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished; falsehood is bound to fade.

quran.text: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave and said: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.
quran.why: A prayer for mercy and for right direction in a hard situation.

quran.text: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works - Lo! We suffer not the reward of one whose work is goodly to be lost.
quran.why: The reward of good work is never lost.

quran.text: Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.
quran.why: Wealth and children adorn this life, but lasting good deeds are better hope.

quran.text: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.
quran.why: If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would run dry first.

quran.text: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
quran.why: For those who believe and do good, the Merciful will create love.

quran.text: My Lord! relieve my mind
quran.why: My Lord, relieve my mind.

quran.text: Ease my task for me.
quran.why: And make my task easy for me.

quran.text: Loose a knot from my tongue.
quran.why: A prayer to be freed from the knot in one's tongue.

quran.text: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
quran.why: Do not fear; I am with you, hearing and seeing.

quran.text: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
quran.why: Our Lord gave everything its nature, then guided it.

quran.text: Lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.
quran.why: God forgives whoever repents, believes, does good and keeps to the right way.

quran.text: He who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage).
quran.why: Whoever does good need not fear injustice or being cheated of their due.

quran.text: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
quran.why: Pray: my Lord, increase me in knowledge.

quran.text: We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
quran.why: No soul will be wronged at all; even a mustard seed's weight is counted.

quran.text: Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
quran.why: Job cried out: hardship has touched me, and You are the most merciful.

quran.text: Whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.
quran.why: No good effort is rejected; it is recorded.

quran.text: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art best of all who show mercy.
quran.why: Pray: my Lord, forgive and have mercy; You are the best of the merciful.

quran.text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.
quran.why: God is the light of the heavens and earth: light upon light.

quran.text: He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
quran.why: Night and day follow each other for whoever wants to remember or give thanks.

quran.text: Those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two.
quran.why: When spending, be neither wasteful nor stingy, but in between.

quran.text: Whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance.
quran.why: Whoever repents and does good truly turns back to God.

quran.text: Those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
quran.why: Do not take part in falsehood, and pass by idle mockery with dignity.

quran.text: My Lord is with me. He will guide me.
quran.why: Moses says: my Lord is with me; He will guide me.

quran.text: When I sicken, then He healeth me.
quran.why: When I fall ill, it is God who heals me.

quran.text: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
quran.why: Do not cheat people of what is theirs or spread corruption.

quran.text: Put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
quran.why: Put your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

quran.text: We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors.
quran.why: God wills to show favour to those who were oppressed.

quran.text: He escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.
quran.why: Moses fled danger, watchful and afraid, praying to be kept safe from those who would harm him.

quran.text: When he turned his face toward Midian, he said: Peradventure my Lord will guide me in the right road.
quran.why: Setting out for an unknown place: perhaps my Lord will guide me the right way.

quran.text: He watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.
quran.why: After helping strangers, Moses prayed: I am in need of whatever good You send me.

quran.text: O my father! Hire him! For the best (man) that thou canst hire is the strong, the trustworthy.
quran.why: The best one to hire is the strong and trustworthy.

quran.text: When they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.
quran.why: When they hear idle talk they turn away and say: peace be with you.

quran.text: Of His mercy hath He appointed for you night and day, that therein ye may rest, and that ye may seek His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful.
quran.why: Night and day are a mercy: one for rest, one for seeking your living.

quran.text: Whosoever striveth, striveth only for himself, for lo! Allah is altogether Independent of (His) creatures.
quran.why: Whoever strives, strives for their own good.

quran.text: Argue not with the People of the Scripture unless it be in (a way) that is better, save with such of them as do wrong; and say: We believe in that which hath been revealed unto us and revealed unto you; our Allah and your Allah is One, and unto Him we surrender.
quran.why: Discuss differences of faith only in the best way: our God and your God is One.

quran.text: How many an animal there is that beareth not its own provision! Allah provideth for it and for you. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
quran.why: Many creatures carry no provision, yet God provides for them and for you.

quran.text: As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good.
quran.why: Those who strive for God are guided to His paths.

quran.text: Of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Lo! herein indeed are portents for men of knowledge.
quran.why: The variety of your languages and colours is a sign for those who know.

quran.text: Of His signs is your slumber by night and by day, and your seeking of His bounty. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who heed.
quran.why: Your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty are signs for those who listen.

quran.text: Give to the kinsman his due, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah's Countenance. And such are they who are successful.
quran.why: Give relatives, the needy and travellers their due.

quran.text: Allah is He Who shaped you out of weakness, then appointed after weakness strength, then, after strength, appointed weakness and grey hair. He createth what He will. He is the Knower, the Mighty.
quran.why: Life moves from weakness to strength and back to weakness; all is in God's hands.

quran.text: Verily We gave Luqman wisdom, saying: Give thanks unto Allah; and whosoever giveth thanks, he giveth thanks for (the good of) his soul. And whosoever refuseth - Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.
quran.why: God gave Luqman wisdom and told him to give thanks; whoever gives thanks does so for their own good.

quran.text: O my dear son! Lo! though it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.
quran.why: A father teaches: even a mustard seed's weight, hidden in a rock, God brings to light.

quran.text: Turn not thy cheek in scorn toward folk, nor walk with pertness in the land. Lo! Allah loveth not each braggart boaster.
quran.why: Do not turn your face from people in scorn or walk proudly.

quran.text: If all the trees in the earth were pens, and the sea, with seven more seas to help it, (were ink), the words of Allah could not be exhausted. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.
quran.why: If every tree were a pen and the sea ink, God's words would not run out.

quran.text: Put thy trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as Trustee.
quran.why: Put your trust in God; He is enough to rely on.

quran.text: Those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin.
quran.why: Those who malign the innocent carry the guilt of slander.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight.
quran.why: Moses was slandered, but God cleared his name.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point.
quran.why: Speak words that are straight and true.

quran.text: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.
quran.why: Whatever you spend for good, God replaces it.

quran.text: He it is Who accepteth repentance from His bondmen, and pardoneth the evil deeds, and knoweth what ye do.
quran.why: God accepts repentance and pardons wrongs.

quran.text: He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy. He is the Protecting Friend, the Praiseworthy.
quran.why: God sends saving rain after people have despaired.

quran.text: Hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
quran.why: All that is in the heavens and earth has been made of service to you.

quran.text: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm.
quran.why: Help God's cause and He will help you and steady your feet.

quran.text: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.
quran.why: Believers are siblings, so make peace between them.

quran.text: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
quran.why: Peoples were made different so they might know one another; the noblest is the best in conduct.

quran.text: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
quran.why: God knows what your soul whispers and is nearer than your own jugular vein.

quran.text: In their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
quran.why: In their wealth was a rightful share for the one who asks and the one who goes without.

quran.text: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
quran.why: It is God who gives livelihood.

quran.text: That his effort will be seen.
quran.why: And their effort will be seen.

quran.text: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
quran.why: Every day God is at work.

quran.text: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
quran.why: Is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?

quran.text: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
quran.why: God is with you wherever you are.

quran.text: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.
quran.why: God heard the woman who brought her complaint about her husband.

quran.text: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful.
quran.why: Those who welcomed refugees put them first even in poverty; freedom from greed is success.

quran.text: Those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.
quran.why: Pray: forgive us and those before us, and leave no bitterness in our hearts.

quran.text: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not?
quran.why: Why say what you do not do?

quran.text: When the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful.
quran.why: After prayer, go out and seek your living, remembering God often.

quran.text: Whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.
quran.why: Whoever puts their trust in God, He is enough for them; God has set a measure for all things.

quran.text: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.
quran.why: Give according to your means; after hardship, God brings ease.

quran.text: We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you.
quran.why: We feed you for God's sake alone, wanting no reward or thanks.

quran.text: Have appointed your sleep for repose.
quran.why: Your sleep is made for rest.

quran.text: He is successful who groweth.
quran.why: Whoever grows in goodness has succeeded.

quran.text: To be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
quran.why: Be among those who encourage one another to persevere and to be compassionate.

quran.text: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee.
quran.why: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor does He hate you.

quran.text: Verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
quran.why: Your Lord will give you, and you will be content.

quran.text: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
quran.why: Were you not an orphan, and He sheltered you?

quran.text: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
quran.why: Did He not find you wandering and guide you?

quran.text: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
quran.why: Were you not in need, and He provided for you?

quran.text: The orphan oppress not.
quran.why: So do not oppress the orphan.

quran.text: The beggar drive not away.
quran.why: And do not turn away the one who asks.

quran.text: Of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
quran.why: And speak of your Lord's blessings.

quran.text: Lo! with hardship goeth ease.
quran.why: With hardship comes ease.

quran.text: Surely We created man of the best stature
quran.why: People were created in the finest form.

quran.text: Whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then.
quran.why: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.

bible.text: On the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
bible.why: Even the Creator rested from work; rest is part of a good life.

bible.text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
bible.why: Do not speak falsely about others.

bible.text: Thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
bible.why: Remember how it feels to be a stranger and do not oppress one.

bible.text: The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth.
bible.why: God is described as merciful, gracious, patient and full of goodness.

bible.text: When ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
bible.why: Leave something of your harvest for those in need.

bible.text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
bible.why: Do not steal, deceive, or lie to one another.

bible.text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
bible.why: Judge fairly, favouring neither the poor nor the powerful.

bible.text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
bible.why: Do not take revenge or hold grudges; love your neighbour as yourself.

bible.text: If a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
bible.why: Do not mistreat a stranger living among you.

bible.text: The stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
bible.why: Treat the stranger as one of your own and love them as yourself.

bible.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee.
bible.why: A blessing: may you be kept safe.

bible.text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.
bible.why: A blessing of grace and kindness shining on you.

bible.text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
bible.why: A blessing of peace.

bible.text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
bible.why: When you have eaten and are full, give thanks for the good you have.

bible.text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
bible.why: God cares for the orphan, the widow and the stranger, giving food and clothing.

bible.text: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
bible.why: Love the stranger, for you were once strangers too.

bible.text: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother.
bible.why: Do not harden your heart or close your hand to a neighbour in need.

bible.text: The poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
bible.why: Open your hand wide to the poor and needy.

bible.text: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bible.why: Follow what is fully just.

bible.text: Thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bible.why: Keep honest weights and fair measures in your dealings.

bible.text: The LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
bible.why: The LORD goes before you and will not fail or forsake you; do not fear or be dismayed.

bible.text: The Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
bible.why: People look at outward appearance, but God looks at the heart.

bible.text: Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
bible.why: When the journey is too great for you, get up and eat.

bible.text: They sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
bible.why: Friends sat silently with a grieving man, simply being present.

bible.text: There is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
bible.why: Even a tree that is cut down can sprout again.

bible.text: Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
bible.why: Reverence is wisdom, and turning from evil is understanding.

bible.text: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
bible.why: Job says he never let a stranger sleep in the street but opened his door to travellers.

bible.text: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
bible.why: The breath of life in you was given by God.

bible.text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
bible.why: I lay down and slept, and woke again, sustained.

bible.text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still.
bible.why: Stand in awe and do not sin; search your heart on your bed and be still.

bible.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
bible.why: A prayer for mercy and healing when weak and aching.

bible.text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
bible.why: A refuge for the oppressed in times of trouble.

bible.text: They that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
bible.why: Those who seek God are not forsaken.

bible.text: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
bible.why: With the Lord before me, I shall not be shaken.

bible.text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
bible.why: God is my rock, fortress and deliverer, in whom I trust.

bible.text: Thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
bible.why: God will light my candle and brighten my darkness.

bible.text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
bible.why: May my words and thoughts be pleasing.

bible.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
bible.why: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not lack.

bible.text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
bible.why: He restores my soul and leads me in right paths.

bible.text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
bible.why: A prayer to be shown the right way.

bible.text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
bible.why: Lead me in truth and teach me; I wait on you all day.

bible.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
bible.why: Remember not the sins of my youth, but remember me in mercy.

bible.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
bible.why: Turn to me and have mercy, for I am desolate and afflicted.

bible.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
bible.why: The Lord is my light and my strength; whom shall I fear?

bible.text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
bible.why: I would have fainted had I not believed I would see goodness.

bible.text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
bible.why: Wait, be of good courage, and your heart will be strengthened.

bible.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
bible.why: The Lord is my strength and shield; my heart trusts and is helped.

bible.text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
bible.why: The Lord gives strength and the blessing of peace.

bible.text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
bible.why: I cried out and was healed.

bible.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness.
bible.why: My mourning has been turned into dancing.

bible.text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
bible.why: Blessed is the one whose wrongs are forgiven.

bible.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin.
bible.why: I admitted my wrong instead of hiding it, and was forgiven.

bible.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
bible.why: I will teach you and guide you in the way you should go.

bible.text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
bible.why: I sought the Lord and was freed from all my fears.

bible.text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
bible.why: Those who looked to him were lightened, and their faces were not ashamed.

bible.text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
bible.why: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceit.

bible.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
bible.why: Turn from evil, do good, seek peace and pursue it.

bible.text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
bible.why: The Lord is near to the broken-hearted.

bible.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
bible.why: Many troubles come, but there is deliverance from them all.

bible.text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
bible.why: Trust, do good, and you will be provided for.

bible.text: He shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
bible.why: He will bring out your righteousness like the light and your cause like the noonday.

bible.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
bible.why: Stop being angry and let go of wrath; do not fret yourself into doing evil.

bible.text: The meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
bible.why: The meek shall inherit the earth and delight in abundant peace.

bible.text: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
bible.why: The steps of a good person are guided.

bible.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
bible.why: Though you fall, you will not be utterly cast down; you are held up.

bible.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
bible.why: All my longing and groaning are not hidden from you.

bible.text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
bible.why: A prayer: do not forsake me, do not be far from me.

bible.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
bible.why: I waited patiently, and my cry was heard.

bible.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
bible.why: Lifted out of the pit and set on solid rock.

bible.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
bible.why: Blessed is the one who considers the poor.

bible.text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
bible.why: Strength is given on the sickbed; care in sickness.

bible.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
bible.why: Why are you downcast, my soul? Hope still.

bible.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
bible.why: Why are you troubled, my soul? Hope in God, for I will yet praise him.

bible.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
bible.why: God is our refuge and strength, a present help in trouble.

bible.text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea.
bible.why: We will not fear even if the earth itself gives way.

bible.text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
bible.why: Wash me and cleanse me of my wrongdoing.

bible.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
bible.why: Create in me a clean heart and renew a right spirit.

bible.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
bible.why: Restore to me the joy of being saved; uphold me.

bible.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
bible.why: A broken and contrite heart will not be despised.

bible.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
bible.why: Cast your burden on the Lord and you will be sustained.

bible.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
bible.why: When I am afraid, I will trust.

bible.text: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
bible.why: Every tear you shed is seen and kept.

bible.text: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
bible.why: I take refuge under the shadow of your wings until troubles pass.

bible.text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
bible.why: My soul waits on God; my salvation comes from him.

bible.text: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
bible.why: My soul, wait only on God, for my hope comes from him.

bible.text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.
bible.why: Trust at all times; pour out your heart.

bible.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
bible.why: A father to the fatherless and defender of widows.

bible.text: Thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
bible.why: You have been my hope and trust since my youth.

bible.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
bible.why: Do not cast me off in old age, when my strength fails.

bible.text: Also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
bible.why: Even when I am old and grey, do not forsake me until I have shown your strength to the next generation.

bible.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
bible.why: My body and heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart.

bible.text: Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
bible.why: Full of compassion, gracious, patient, abundant in mercy and truth.

bible.text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
bible.why: Satisfy us early with mercy, so we may rejoice all our days.

bible.text: Let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
bible.why: Establish the work of our hands.

bible.text: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
bible.why: He is my refuge and fortress, in whom I trust.

bible.text: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
bible.why: You are covered and sheltered as under wings.

bible.text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.
bible.why: You need not fear terror by night.

bible.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High.
bible.why: It is a good thing to give thanks.

bible.text: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
bible.why: When I said my foot was slipping, mercy held me up.

bible.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
bible.why: When my thoughts within me are many, your comforts delight my soul.

bible.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
bible.why: Forget not all the good you have received.

bible.text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
bible.why: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, plentiful in mercy.

bible.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
bible.why: As a father has compassion on his children, so does the Lord.

bible.text: He knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
bible.why: He knows how we are made; he remembers that we are dust.

bible.text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bible.why: Give thanks, for he is good and his mercy endures.

bible.text: He satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
bible.why: He satisfies the longing soul and fills the hungry with good.

bible.text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
bible.why: He makes the storm calm and the waves still.

bible.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
bible.why: Not afraid of bad news, with a heart steady in trust.

bible.text: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
bible.why: I love the Lord because he heard my voice.

bible.text: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
bible.why: I called out in distress and was answered and set free.

bible.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
bible.why: The Lord is with me; I will not fear what people can do.

bible.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
bible.why: This is the day; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

bible.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
bible.why: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me.

bible.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
bible.why: This is my comfort in affliction.

bible.text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
bible.why: Let your merciful kindness be my comfort.

bible.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
bible.why: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

bible.text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
bible.why: Great peace have those who love your law.

bible.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
bible.why: I lift my eyes to the hills, from where my help comes.

bible.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
bible.why: My help comes from the maker of heaven and earth.

bible.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
bible.why: He will not let your foot slip; he who keeps you does not sleep.

bible.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
bible.why: The Lord will keep you from harm and preserve your soul.

bible.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
bible.why: Your going out and coming in are kept, now and always.

bible.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
bible.why: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

bible.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
bible.why: One who goes out weeping, carrying seed, will return rejoicing with the harvest.

bible.text: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
bible.why: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labour in vain.

bible.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
bible.why: I wait, and in his word I hope.

bible.text: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
bible.why: My heart is not proud; I do not occupy myself with things too great for me.

bible.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
bible.why: How good it is for people to live together in unity.

bible.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bible.why: Give thanks, for he is good; his mercy endures forever.

bible.text: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
bible.why: When I called, I was answered and given strength in my soul.

bible.text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
bible.why: What concerns me will be brought to completion.

bible.text: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
bible.why: You have searched me and known me.

bible.text: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
bible.why: You know my path and all my ways.

bible.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
bible.why: There is nowhere I could go to be away from your presence.

bible.text: The darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
bible.why: Darkness is not dark to you; the night shines like the day.

bible.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
bible.why: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

bible.text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
bible.why: How precious are your thoughts toward me.

bible.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
bible.why: Let me hear your kindness in the morning and know the way to walk.

bible.text: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
bible.why: Teach me to do your will; lead me into the land of uprightness.

bible.text: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
bible.why: The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger.

bible.text: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
bible.why: The Lord is good to all, and his mercy is over all he has made.

bible.text: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
bible.why: He upholds all who fall and lifts up those who are bowed down.

bible.text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
bible.why: The Lord is near to all who call on him sincerely.

bible.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
bible.why: He heals the broken-hearted and binds up their wounds.

bible.text: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels.
bible.why: A wise person keeps listening and learning.

bible.text: The LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
bible.why: Wisdom, knowledge and understanding come from God.

bible.text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
bible.why: Acknowledge him in all your ways and your paths will be directed.

bible.text: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
bible.why: Happy is the one who finds wisdom and gains understanding.

bible.text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
bible.why: Wisdom's ways are pleasant and all her paths are peace.

bible.text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
bible.why: Do not withhold good when it is in your power to do it.

bible.text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
bible.why: Do not tell a neighbour to come back tomorrow when you can help today.

bible.text: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
bible.why: Wisdom is the main thing; above all, get understanding.

bible.text: The path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
bible.why: The path of the just is like a shining light that grows brighter until the perfect day.

bible.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
bible.why: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it come the issues of life.

bible.text: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
bible.why: Let your eyes look straight ahead.

bible.text: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
bible.why: Consider the path of your feet and your ways will be steady.

bible.text: Wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
bible.why: Wisdom is better than rubies.

bible.text: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
bible.why: Teach a wise person and they become wiser still.

bible.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
bible.why: Reverence is the beginning of wisdom.

bible.text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
bible.why: Whoever walks with integrity walks securely.

bible.text: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
bible.why: Dishonest scales are hated; fair dealing is a delight.
